submitted: Your assignment has been submitted successfully!
error: The request could not be completed. Check the fields and connection, then try again. If another organizer changed this record, reload it first.
phaseWindow: Each phase must start on or after the assignment start and end on or before its final deadline. Check the seconds as well as the date and time.
overlappingPhases: Submission phases overlap. End one phase before or exactly when the next phase starts.
invalidDates: Enter a valid start and final deadline in Asia/Amman. The deadline must be later than the start.
invalidConfiguration: Check required fields and phase names, dates and points. Each phase needs a start before its end and points from zero upward, with at most two decimal places.
invalidLinks: Use complete http:// or https:// reference links, one per line, without usernames or passwords.
unauthorized: Your account does not have permission for this action. Your unfinished work has been kept.
expiredSession: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue; your private draft has been kept.
networkError: The connection failed. Your entered information is still here. Reconnect and try again.
conflict: Another save changed this record. Your inputs have been kept. Reload and review the current record before saving again.
emptyAdmin: No assignments yet. Create one when you are ready.
studentHelp: Submit once. Your confirmed submission becomes read-only. Points appear after an organizer reviews your work.
adminHelp: Assignments outside weekly classroom sessions. Week 1 Dataset and Bingo remain managed inside their own pages.
confirmDelete: Delete this item? This cannot be undone.
rulesLocked: Submissions lock phase rules, dates and submission type. Instructions and visibility can still be edited.
boundaries: Times are in Asia/Amman. Start is inclusive; end and deadline are exclusive. Submissions in gaps between phases are not accepted.
fileHelp: PDF, CSV, XLSX, PBIX or ZIP. Maximum 20 MiB. Files remain private.
resumeUpload: Finish your existing upload using the same file, then submit again.
participationHelp: Approve one valid submitted attempt per student. Additional attempts do not earn additional points.
name: Student name
rankingRules: Every eligible registered student is included, even with zero points. Approved assignment points and Dataset participation count; Bingo never awards points. Ties use stable student ID order. Week 1 runs November 19 to November 20, 2026 at 00:00 Asia/Amman; later weeks run Friday 00:00 to the next Friday 00:00. Assignments follow their original publication/start period and Dataset follows its session period, even when reviewed later. Earlier approved points remain in All-Time. Archive membership requires eligibility at the cutoff and respects current privacy and administrative-role exclusions.
publicNameHelp: Eligible students can choose to show the full name saved during registration. The name is public on the leaderboard; contact details and submissions remain private. You can withdraw consent at any time.
publicNameConsent: I agree to show my saved registration full name on the public leaderboard.
publicNamePrivacyNotice: If you do not opt in, your existing anonymous leaderboard alias stays visible.
privateHelp: Save Changes stores your edits. To make resources visible, explicitly show a topic AND enable session visibility, then save. Both settings are required. Newly added topics stay hidden. Organizer notes always stay private.
sessionVisibility: Show this session's selected topics to students
topicVisibility: Visible after Save Changes when the session is shown
sessionSaved: Session changes saved. Student visibility follows the saved session and topic Show / Hide settings. Private notes remain private.
publicEmpty: No session resources have been published.
sessionShown: Session visibility: shown. Only topics marked Show will reach students after Save Changes.
sessionHidden: Session visibility: hidden. No topics are visible to students.
noSelectedTopics: No topics are selected yet. Choose Show on a topic and save to display it.
waitingForSession: Selected, but hidden while the session is hidden
periodBoundary: Start is inclusive; end is exclusive. The full last minute of Thursday counts. Later weeks start Friday at 00:00 Asia/Amman; Week 1 is the opening day, November 19.
scoringUpcoming: Scoring begins on November 19, 2026. Current-week totals remain zero until the opening period starts.
archivePolicy: Original cutoff points remain available. Late approvals and corrections are dated adjustments to this source week, with a new revision. All-Time always retains approved points.
archivePrivacy: Current privacy and eligibility still apply. Original rank numbers are retained and may have gaps when historic participants are withheld.
awardSaved: Award recorded and leaderboard totals refreshed.
awardInvalidAmount: Enter a positive whole number up to 999,999,999,999,999.
awardInvalidReason: Enter a reason of 1 to 1,000 characters.
awardHistoryEmpty: No manual awards have been recorded.
